data.name: Mega Golf
data.detailed_description:
Mega Golf is the unholy love child of mini-golf and vehicular combat. Be the first into the hole, or spend your time dropping landmines and smashing other players into the ocean. Master the hazards, study the bounce pads, and search for hidden paths as you try to stay alive and complete the course the fastest.

Features:

  • Solo or Local Multiplayer Mayhem – Compete against friends on the same machine or challenge yourself across increasingly absurd and occasionally guarded courses. Mega Golf supports 4 local players, or play at a distance over Steam Remote Play.

  • Weaponized Momentum – Your greatest weapon is speed. Build momentum, launch off ramps and bounce pads, blast through buildings and roll over cars as you steamroll your way to the end of the course.

  • Vehicular Combat Meets Golf – Work your way methodically to the end of the course, or spend some shots smashing your friends off course and into dangerous obstacles. These balls are made for violence. 

  • Physics-Driven Chaos – Every impact matters. Ricochet off crumbling buildings or bounce your way from exploding car to exploding car as you plot your way to the hole.
